records.trigger: An implementer holding the owner lease can supply the session identity that a topology critic signs its receipt under, because deriveRoleProvenance never checks where that identity came from.
records.observedFailure: resolveSessionIdentity({LATTICE_SESSION_ID:'sess-anything-the-implementer-types'}) returns sessionId sess-anything-the-implementer-types with sessionSource explicit-env, and deriveRoleProvenance accepts that session for signing without inspecting its provenance. independenceMatrix then reports session independence as true because it is a textual comparison against the implementation session id, so an implementer who also dispatches controls both sides of the check. Demonstrated live during B-3f3d: a dispatch event recorded under an implementer-chosen session id satisfied every mechanical check, and only an independent critic refusing to adopt the session prevented a self-signed receipt.
